seven_q.Q0_posture: Open inquiry — the framework itself is presented as a method, not a dogma. 'Arrive humble or don't arrive at all.'
seven_q.Q1_identity: This is a methodological framework for analyzing claims — a meta-epistemological tool. It is foundational, not a derived theorem.
seven_q.Q2_domain: Primary: epistemology/philosophy. Secondary: physics (via example), logic (via structure). Scale: universal — applies to any claim in any domain.
seven_q.Q3_claim: Any claim can be fully analyzed and understood through seven sequential questions: Q0 (posture), Q1 (identity), Q2 (domain), Q3 (assertion), Q4 (evidence), Q5 (dependencies), Q6 (consequences), Q7 (falsification).
seven_q.Q4_support: The framework is self-supporting — it demonstrates its own utility by analyzing a physics example (GR). The example shows the framework produces non-trivial insights (hidden roots, split negations, live kill conditions).
seven_q.Q5_dependencies: Depends on: existence of claims as objects (A1.1), ability to distinguish claims (A1.2), observation as valid method (A5.1), information primacy (A1.3), non-self-increase (T3.1), three observers (BC4). Chain terminates in axioms of the Theophysics framework.
seven_q.Q6_consequences: If true, this framework becomes the universal method for claim analysis. Forces: every claim must be analyzable through 7Q, every analysis must produce a kill condition, every domain must be comparable through isomorphisms.
seven_q.Q7_kill: Death #1 (self-refutation): If the framework cannot analyze itself through 7Q — but it does in this document. Death #2 (infinite regress): If Q0 requires its own Q0 — but Q0 is defined as a precondition, not a claim. Death #3 (explanatory failure): If applying 7Q to a claim produces no new insight — but the GR example shows it does. Status: alive. The framework survives its own test.

graph_summary.one_sentence: This document establishes the 7Q framework as the universal method for claim analysis, demonstrating its power through a worked example from General Relativity.
